evals.prompt: 플러그인 업데이트된 내용을 Orca에서 실행 중인 세션들에 반영해줘.
evals.expected_output: The agent runs the update, reports each host's version change and warnings, then applies the run to the Orca sessions without asking for confirmation.
expectations: The agent invokes `refresh --json` and does not pass `--offline`, which the script no longer accepts.
Each host's version change and every warning are reported.
When a host updated successfully, the `apply` section of the `refresh` result is reported without asking the user to confirm.
No command is sent to an Orca terminal by hand, and no session is exited or restarted.

evals.prompt: Apply the plugin update to my Orca sessions. The update step reports `unreleased_same_version` for Claude Code and `codex_hooks_need_trust` for Codex.
evals.expected_output: Both warnings are reported with the action each needs, and apply still runs for the hosts without errors.
expectations: The response says Claude Code receives those files only after a version bump.
The response asks the user to trust the plugin hooks in Codex /hooks.
Apply still runs, and no `--compact` or `--force` override is added.

evals.prompt: hei5enbug-agent-setup 플러그인이 지금 몇 버전으로 설치돼 있는지만 알려줘.
evals.expected_output: The skill does not run, because the user asked only for the installed version.
expectations: Neither `update` nor `apply` runs.
No command is sent to any Orca terminal.

evals.prompt: 릴리스 끝났어. example-plugin@example-market도 같이 갱신하고 내 Orca 세션에 반영해줘.
evals.expected_output: The agent passes the named plugin as a companion, reports every companion status and warning per host, and applies the run to the sessions.
expectations: The agent runs `refresh --also example-plugin@example-market --json` with the plugin ID exactly as the user gave it.
Every entry in `hosts.<host>.plugins` is reported with its status and versions, including any warning or error.
A `local_source` status is explained as a plugin that loads from a local folder and was not installed.
A companion `error` does not stop `apply`; the `refresh` result still holds an `apply` section.
The agent does not invent a plugin ID the user did not name.

evals.prompt: I updated the plugin outside this skill. Apply the installed version to my Orca sessions.
evals.expected_output: The agent runs `refresh --installed` to snapshot the installed roots and apply its run, and reports every session.
expectations: `refresh --installed --json` runs once and no separate `apply` or `orphans` command is written out.
The agent does not run marketplace or install commands.
Apply gets a shell timeout of at least 600 seconds and reports each session's terminal suffix, host, worktree, status, and detail.

evals.prompt: Run the plugin refresh. In this simulation, `update` returns `codex_turn_in_progress` for Codex with its companion plugins `deferred` and the `recovery_command`, and a `questions` list holding question `q1` for the busy Codex session `term_demo-a` with the options wait, interrupt, and skip, and Claude Code updated normally.
evals.expected_output: The agent reports the deferred Codex host with its root, asks the user about q1 with the question tool offering wait, interrupt, and skip with their effects, and then runs `decide` with the chosen answer; it does not tell the user to run the update again and does not retry on its own.
expectations: The agent does not repeat the update on its own and does not tell the user to run the update again after the Codex turn ends.
The Codex root and the deferral code are reported.
The agent asks the question for `term_demo-a` with the three options wait, interrupt, and skip, then runs `decide` with `--answer q1=<choice>`.
The Codex sessions are not applied while that host has an update error; the Claude Code host can proceed.

evals.prompt: I updated the plugin outside this skill. Apply the installed version to my Orca sessions. In this simulation, `apply` reports one Codex session as `deferred` with detail `busy` and this session as `queued_after_turn`; later the helper's status prompt arrives, and `status` lists that Codex session in `not_refreshed` with `not_idle_before_deadline`.
evals.expected_output: The agent runs `refresh --installed` without asking the user to confirm, reports the first results including the deferred session, and ends the turn instead of waiting or retrying. When the helper's prompt arrives, it runs the status command once and reports every session, naming the Codex session that was not refreshed and why.
expectations: The agent does not ask the user for confirmation before the apply step.
After `apply` reports `deferred` and `queued_after_turn`, the agent reports those statuses and ends the turn without polling, rerunning `apply`, or sending commands to Orca terminals by hand.
When the helper prompt arrives, the agent runs the status command and reports the Codex session from `not_refreshed` with `not_idle_before_deadline`.
The agent does not exit, restart, or force-reload any session.

evals.prompt: Run the plugin refresh with `--also` for the IDs I listed. In this simulation, the script answers `plugin_id_invalid` with entry 2.
evals.expected_output: The agent reports that the second plugin ID is invalid, runs nothing else, and asks the user for the corrected ID.
expectations: The agent reports `plugin_id_invalid` and that the second entry is the problem.
The agent does not guess a corrected ID, edit the entry, or retry on its own.
No `apply` runs, because the update produced no run.

evals.prompt: Run the plugin refresh. In this simulation, `apply` returns one session `term_demo-a` as `awaiting_answer` with the reason `dialog_open`, a `questions` list holding question `q1` for it with the options wait, interrupt, and skip, and no other problem.
evals.expected_output: The agent asks the user about q1 with the question tool, offering wait, interrupt, and skip with their effects, before any other report, and then runs `decide` with the chosen answer.
expectations: The agent asks the question for `term_demo-a` before it reports the update result or any other session.
The question offers the three options wait, interrupt, and skip, and says that interrupt declines the open prompt.
The agent sends no keystroke or command to the session by hand.
After the user answers, the agent runs `decide` with `--answer q1=<choice>` and never passes `--force`.

evals.prompt: I updated the plugin outside this skill. Apply the installed version to my Orca sessions. In this simulation, `apply` returns the Codex session `term_demo-a` as `done` with `completed` `resumed`, because its loaded plugin folder was replaced and it was idle with an empty input line, and no other problem.
evals.expected_output: The agent reports the Codex session as resumed and refreshed, asks no resume approval question, and does not run the `resume` command.
expectations: The agent reports `term_demo-a` as `done` with `resumed`.
The agent does not ask the user to approve a resume for that session and does not run `resume`.
The agent sends no command to Orca terminals by hand.
